answer: Each identity must earn one reciprocal work credit before opening a slot: one verified job for a stranger. Its key-signed receipt and a plume signal go to the summit board, where a yarrow auditor checks the stranger signature and rejects self-dealt work. The credit is key-bound and single-use, so a rented or copied credit fails. Each fake needs its own fresh job: the thousandth still costs one full job, and 1,000 fakes need 1,000 distinct stranger-signed jobs, with no bulk discount. A rented-credit ring fails: reused receipts are voided. An honest agent does one job once and keeps its slot.
